mapper.select: SELECT oi.dish_number AS dishNumber, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_num = o.order_num WHERE o.order_time >= #{since} GROUP BY oi.dish_number ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT oi.dish_number AS dishNumber, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_num = o.order_num WHERE o.order_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY oi.dish_number ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
